How the interview runs

The TikTok SQL interview, as candidates report it

TikTok does not publish the format. Each row is what candidates and prep guides have described publicly, with its source; where sources disagree, the row says so. Formats change — treat every specific as reported, not official.

RolesData Scientist, Data Analyst and Data Engineer.[2]
Data science stagesRecruiter screen, a hiring-manager screen, a technical loop of three or four rounds of about 45 minutes each plus behavioural rounds, then a final manager conversation; all virtual.[1]
Technical screenA 45–60 minute screen on HackerRank covering SQL alongside statistics and probability.[2]
Data analyst screenA 2022 candidate report describes a 30-minute live HackerRank screen: standard joins and window functions plus a short case.[4]
  1. [1] Exponent — TikTok Data Scientist interview guide (updated mid-2026)
  2. [2] DataLemur — TikTok SQL interview questions and data science guide (5 Jan 2025)
  3. [3] DataLemur — second-day confirmation question (undated)
  4. [4] Blind — TikTok data analyst screen report (6 Feb 2022)

Sources: Exponent — TikTok Data Scientist interview guide (updated mid-2026); DataLemur — TikTok SQL interview questions and data science guide (5 Jan 2025); DataLemur — second-day confirmation question (undated); Blind — TikTok data analyst screen report (6 Feb 2022). Accessed 13 Sep 2026.

The SQL that comes up

What TikTok SQL questions test

Reported most often, in order

  • 1Joins across users, videos and events
  • 2Window functions (top video per user per day)
  • 3Aggregation with filtering
  • 4Date logic (confirmed on day 2, per-day grouping)
  • 5Ranking and top-N
  • 6Rates (activation, engagement)
  • 7Tie-breaking rules

Difficulty: Reported as medium, with some reports of medium-to-hard. The data is videos (uploads, likes, dates), user interactions, sign-up and confirmation events, and creator cohorts.

Our TikTok practice set, by skill

The 16 SQL Quest challenges tagged TikTok, resolved onto the nine Skillmap skills. A challenge exercises several skills, so shares do not sum to 100%. This is the composition of the practice set on this page, not a measurement of TikTok’s interview.

Sample questions

TikTok SQL question shapes, and where to practise them

Shapes candidates and guides report (paraphrased)

  • Sign-ups and text confirmations: users who did not confirm on day 1 but did on day 2.[3]
  • The same two tables: the overall activation rate — the share of sign-ups ever confirmed.[2]
  • Videos with uploads and likes: each user's most-liked video per day, the earliest upload winning ties.[2]
